pd_new_teacher_mentoring_001.evidence: Teachers designated through written correspondence by the division of Human Resources as Mentor Teachers, in addition to their normal teaching assignment, will receive a stipend of $500.00 per teacher mentored during the school year. Assignment, training, and responsibilities will be coordinated through the Department of Staff Development.
